snippet.title: Sushi Loop | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🍣 Wishlist Sushi Loop on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4793120/Sushi_Loop/

Build and manage your own conveyor belt sushi restaurant in Sushi Loop.

Prepare fresh sushi, keep the conveyor belt stocked, satisfy hungry customers, and grow your restaurant into the ultimate sushi destination.

Features:
🍣 Prepare and serve sushi
🍱 Manage a moving conveyor belt
⭐ Upgrade and customize your restaurant
👨‍🍳 Keep customers happy

Follow development:
Discord: https://discord.gg/invite/hYz3TckAwg

#indiegame #gamedev #sushi #simulation #managementgame
